post.description:
Register a new user. Enforces unique email + username, stores a bcrypt hash of
the password, and returns a JWT immediately (auto-login on register).

Sent with a guest token, the guest becomes the account in place (same user
id), so everything they made as a guest stays theirs; `claimed_chats` says how many chats.

Verify credentials (email or username + password) and return a JWT. Sent
with a guest token, the guest's chats and today's Plan counts move to the
account and the guest is removed.

Start using the app without an account: a guest session with no email,
name or password (#125). The token lasts 30 days. At most
OTB_GUEST_SESSIONS_PER_IP_DAY new guests a day per IP.

get.description: Return the signed-in user's profile, or a guest's (no email or username).

post.description:
Validate a Brief and return it with its defaults filled in. 422 lists what's
wrong in plain words. No Google or LLM calls; open to everyone.
Apply a BriefPatch to a Brief: only the patch's fields change.

get.description:
The cities that take new Plans, for the web and mobile pickers: South
African cities first (live, then beta), then international ones. Hidden
cities are left out. Open to everyone.

A city's Areas, for picking where a Plan stays (GLOSSARY: Area). 404 for a
city that isn't in the registry or isn't open for planning. Open to everyone.

Ask for a city we don't cover yet, from the city search box (#89). For
accounts and guests, at most 5 a day (UTC) per user.

Search places in one of the supported cities with Google Places.

Rate limited to 20 requests/minute per client (each call hits Google Places).

post.description:
Generate an AI travel itinerary based on target destination, budget, and vibes.
Guests can plan too (#125), under their own lower limits.
This does NOT save it to the DB immediately, allowing client previews first.

Rate limited to 5 requests/minute per user: each call fans out to OpenAI and
multiple Google Places lookups, making it the most expensive route in the API.
Each user can also start only OTB_PLANS_PER_USER_PER_DAY Plans a UTC day;
past that it's a 429 saying when the quota resets.

get.description: List all itineraries saved by the current authenticated user.

Display details for the places of a saved Plan or Saved places, in one
request: name, address, location and types (Place Details Pro). No rating,
hours or price; no photo (that's /places/{id}/photo, when a Stop is opened).
Quota refused or Google down: our catalogue's name and Area instead.
